messages:
alex_support: Heads up — multiple customers are reporting 502/504s hitting the hosted /v1/generate endpoints since ~10:24 UTC. Spike in error rate on the dashboard.

lisa_cs: Which customers are affected? Any billing/latency impact noted?

alex_support: Early hits from org-id: acme-ml and org-id: beta-saas. Latency spikes to 6–12s, then 502. No billing breaks reported yet but requests are failing.

maria_sre: Looking at infra metrics — seeing a huge increase in KV auth failures for prefix-cache in us-west-2 starting at 3723456798. Logs show memcached auth handshake errors: \`AUTH_FAILED\`.

chris_runtime: Repro steps from support curl:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-infer-13b", "input":"hello"}' -v
```

Response body in failed requests: \`{"error":"gateway timeout","code":504}\` after ~10s.

maria_sre: Tracing a sample request — edge -> gateway -> prefix-kv (memcached cluster) -> model pool. The prefix-kv calls are returning TCP resets and auth failures, gateway waits and then times out.

chris_runtime: Is the platform supposed to fallback to origin when cache is unavailable? We have a feature flag that should bypass prefix cache for reads, but looks like the gateway is blocked waiting for the cache call.

maria_sre: Confirmed: the new auth rotation pushed earlier today rotated KMS tokens for memcached and some nodes didn’t pick up the new token, so the cluster rejected connections. A subset of app nodes are hanging waiting for auth handshake.

kv-cache-bot: memcached-cluster/us-west-2: node-7 status=auth_failed, node-9 status=auth_failed, node-11 status=degraded. Rolling restart suggested.

alex_support: ETA on workaround? Customers are asking for an update.

maria_sre: Short-term mitigation: flip gateway config to lower KV call timeout to 250ms and enable fast-fail to origin (bypass cache) for prefix lookups. Applying now as emergency config.

deploy-bot: change-request #CR-4823: set kv.timeout_ms=250 and kv.fast_fail=true — deployed to gateway (us-west-2) at 3723456905 by maria_sre.

chris_runtime: Confirming behavior post-change — traffic that would block on prefix-kv is now passed through to model pool. Error rate dropping, latency back to ~300–600ms for most requests.

lisa_cs: Communicating to affected customers: sending an interim note that the issue is mitigated and we're performing cluster remediation.

maria_sre: Next steps: full cluster audit + restart on affected memcached nodes, validate token sync, add healthcheck to fail fast if auth mismatch seen. I'll open an incident postmortem.

alex_support: Thanks. Please post the incident link here once available. I'll keep CS notified. :thumbsup:

chris_runtime: For the postmortem, include suggested runtime change: make cache calls cancellable at gateway-level so they never block request threads for >X ms.

maria_sre: Agreed. Filing INC-3723 with timeline. Will attach logs and remediation steps.

lisa_cs: Noted — prepping customer follow-up template.

alex_support: Closing thread after postmortem and customer comms.
